name: Go · 9×9
invite_help: Send an invite to start. Black plays first; White gets 7.5 komi.
offline_help: Your board is kept. Play resumes when both players reconnect.
play_help: Place a stone, or pass when you’re ready to score.
passed: The last player passed. Two passes start scoring.
resign_help: Your opponent will win this round. You can still play again.
score_help: Tap a group to mark or restore it. Both players must confirm.
score_wait: Waiting for the other player. Edits reset both confirmations.
rematch_wait: Waiting for the other player to accept.
ko: That move would repeat an earlier board position.
suicide: That stone would leave its group with no liberties.
move_limit: The move limit has been reached; finish scoring.
retry: That action didn’t go through. Try again.
